routing_contract.slug_policy: Same stable ASCII slug across locale prefix; route plan for new draft articles, not a claim these URLs already exist.

implementation_requirements: Extend the existing blog/article path and existing Website Center. Do not create a second CMS or make unrelated CRM changes.
Use stable article IDs, shared ASCII slug and paired English/Arabic routes; store bilingual title, excerpt, body or structured sections, SEO title/description, image alt/caption, and CTA labels.

Expose brand binding, related service bindings, source links/reviewed date, media selection and licence/provenance, author/reviewer identity, draft/publish state and visibility through normal editor controls.
Keep legacy scalar blog rows readable with an explicit migration/fallback. Do not publish English fallback as a complete Arabic translation, or overwrite existing content on seed rerun.
Provide an idempotent seed/import keyed by stable article ID/slug, with conflicts reported. No hardcoded public article bodies that ignore CMS changes.

Render real link elements and readable headings/lists. Current 1d72939 blog renders scalar body text, so adding Markdown syntax to that field alone will not create internal links or structured sections.
Use existing permission and draft/preview/publish boundaries. Saving/importing briefs or complete draft articles must not publish, alter CRM operations or send lead/conversion events.
writing_requirements: Write 75 complete original articles, each with a full English body and full natural Arabic body: 150 locale bodies. These briefs and their headings alone are not the articles.

Answer each specific intent directly, explain the model/generation distinctions, give a practical observation or preparation checklist, explain assessment limits, then offer relevant enquiry links. No arbitrary word count or padding.
Do not copy a single template with brand-name substitutions. Similar categories across brands must retain distinct systems, ownership decisions and useful detail in the brief.

Use primary sources only for the narrowly supported facts. A current, UK or US model page does not establish UAE equipment, older generations, SHWURX capability, common fault frequency or maintenance intervals.

Do not invent completed jobs, testimonials, technicians, accreditations, dealer affiliation, diagnostic-tool access, OEM coding access, prices, warranties or repair success. Do not repeat unsupported claims already present in old seed text.

General inspection or service requests are conditional on exact model/year/equipment and confirmed workshop capability. No high-voltage, carbon-structure or ADAS procedure claims without verified competence and equipment.
Source facts were researched on 2026-10-05. Recheck the exact model/year/market source while drafting and before approval; preserve source URLs, factual support and reviewed date in CMS.
Drafts must be editable in existing /marketing Website Center, previewable in both locales, and excluded from public queries, sitemap and structured data until the publishing gate passes.
seo_requirements: Emit locale-specific title, description, self canonical and reciprocal en/ar alternate URLs for complete published translations. Keep language switch on the same article.

Published brand pages should link their five genuinely relevant articles; articles link the same-locale brand, selected services and #enquire destination. Contextual links should use descriptive text.
Include only published, indexable, complete locale URLs in sitemap. Draft preview should be noindex and excluded from public feeds/search; unpublished records must not leak in public payloads.

Article or BlogPosting structured data must match visible content, actual author attribution, real dates and relevant images. Do not mark educational content as a completed repair or invent review ratings.
Use crawlable, responsive images with intrinsic dimensions, useful localized alt text and accurate captions. Do not keyword-stuff titles, alt text or every heading.
Do not promise Google rankings or rich results. Search value comes from useful, accurate, distinct content and accessible pages, not a 75-article count.

rules: A correct-brand original may still depict the wrong model/system for an article. Do not assign a generic car shot as diagnostic proof.
Original archive photos do not prove model year, exact work, repair outcome or a current location. Historical Range Rover workshop placard must not establish the current Al Quoz address.
AI imagery, including fictional portraits and facade concepts, is illustrative only. Never present it as real staff, workshop premises, customer work, before/after evidence or testimonials.
For illustrative brand/model images, record that status and display an appropriate caption: Illustrative image / صورة توضيحية. Do not imply official manufacturer endorsement.
Manufacturer web images are research references, not an automatic commercial-use licence. Use approved original, explicitly licensed or clearly labelled illustrative artwork.
Protect plates/faces/customer documents and retain original files. Use CMS media provenance, localized alt and caption fields; do not substitute a wrong-brand photo merely to fill every card.

outline.en: Document whether the issue concerns deployment, panel alignment or paint finish.
outline.ar: حدّد هل المشكلة في خروج المقبض أم محاذاة الجزء أم تشطيب الدهان.

outline.en: Record when the symptom began relative to an impact or earlier door work.
outline.ar: سجّل وقت ظهور العرض بالنسبة لأي صدمة أو عمل سابق بالباب.

outline.en: Inspect the finish boundary and mechanical/electrical operation as separate checks.
outline.ar: افصل فحص حدود التشطيب عن فحص الحركة والتشغيل الكهربائي.

outline.en: Agree the assessment scope without assuming a new handle or software update will solve it.
outline.ar: حدّد نطاق الفحص دون افتراض أن تغيير المقبض أو تحديث البرنامج سيحل المشكلة.

sources.factual_support: The manufacturer documents Velar deployable flush door handles.

subject.en: Original close-up of a verified Velar handle and surrounding panel, showing both positions only if safely documented.

title.en: Range Rover camera complaints: identify ClearSight and surround view separately
title.ar: مشكلات كاميرات رينج روفر: حدّد كلير سايت والرؤية المحيطية كلًا على حدة

search_intent.en: Range Rover ClearSight or surround-camera image issue after bodywork
search_intent.ar: مشكلة صورة كلير سايت أو الكاميرات المحيطية بعد إصلاح الهيكل

articles.model_scope: Equipped Range Rover vehicles, 2016+ only; current manufacturer feature examples must not be applied to older unequipped vehicles.

outline.en: Identify the affected view: rear-view mirror feed, parking camera or surround view.
outline.ar: حدّد الصورة المتأثرة: المرآة الرقمية أم كاميرا الركن أم الرؤية المحيطية.

outline.en: Record whether the image problem followed body, trim or glass work.
outline.ar: سجّل إن كانت المشكلة ظهرت بعد أعمال هيكل أو كسوة أو زجاج.

outline.en: Document visible obstruction and display messages before assuming a camera has failed.
outline.ar: وثّق العائق الظاهر ورسائل الشاشة قبل افتراض تلف الكاميرا.

outline.en: Determine any required calibration from the exact manufacturer procedure and verified equipment.
outline.ar: حدّد الحاجة إلى المعايرة من إجراء الشركة الخاص بالموديل والتجهيزات المتاحة فعليًا.
